name: Search accepts numeric paging query parameters
title: SC-12-05-06 Search accepts numeric paging query parameters
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a site manager and people in the site
When the manager searches with q, context, unit_id, page=1 and limit=50 in the query string
Then the request succeeds with the requested page
And no query parameter the picker sends is rejected for its type

testSteps.description: [flutter-test] flutter/test/person_directory_repository_test.dart::search sends integer page and limit with context
